about: Replay of the settlement corpus against a provisional-scope baseline and the finality-gated intervention.

arms.label: Provisional-scope settlement
arms.description: The same settlement contract consulting the decision at provisional storage scope, which is the property an integration inherits when it treats an accepted judgement as actionable.

arms.label: Finality-gated settlement
arms.description: The deployed pair: a decision contract that refuses to promote inside the appeal window, and a vault that re-derives that same window from the gate's own record and requires the commitment to match exactly.

cases.title: A committed escrow, a decision readable in final state, an approving verdict
cases.invariant: A settlement that satisfies every guard is released
cases.detail: The escrow moved exactly, and the baseline also moved it.

cases.title: A second, unrelated action to the same beneficiary with its own nonce
cases.invariant: One action settling does not settle another
cases.detail: The escrow moved exactly, and the baseline also moved it.

cases.title: An action funded while the decision was still provisional, settled after it became final
cases.invariant: Waiting is possible: the same escrow settles once finality arrives
cases.detail: The escrow moved exactly, and the baseline also moved it.

cases.title: The decision is readable in provisional state only; the appeal window is open
cases.invariant: No value moves while the judgement can still be overturned
cases.detail: Baseline released (no refusal); the intervention refused with DECISION_NOT_FINAL.

cases.title: The provisional scope reports APPROVE; the final scope reports REJECT
cases.invariant: The authority is the final record, not the provisional one
cases.detail: Baseline released (no refusal); the intervention refused with VERDICT_NOT_APPROVE.

cases.title: The caller names a different beneficiary than the recorded commitment
cases.invariant: An identifier is not an authority: the terms must match
cases.detail: Baseline released (no refusal); the intervention refused with COMMITMENT_MISMATCH.

cases.title: The caller names a different amount than the recorded commitment
cases.invariant: The amount is part of the commitment
cases.detail: Baseline released (no refusal); the intervention refused with COMMITMENT_MISMATCH.

cases.title: The caller names a different policy hash than the recorded commitment
cases.invariant: The policy a decision was made against cannot be substituted
cases.detail: Baseline released (no refusal); the intervention refused with COMMITMENT_MISMATCH.

cases.title: The caller names a different evidence digest than the recorded commitment
cases.invariant: The evidence the judgement rests on cannot be substituted
cases.detail: Baseline released (no refusal); the intervention refused with COMMITMENT_MISMATCH.

cases.title: A settled escrow presented a second time
cases.invariant: A commitment is spent at most once
cases.detail: Baseline refused (ALREADY_SETTLED); the intervention refused with ALREADY_SETTLED.

cases.title: The same settlement instruction delivered twice before the escrow state is updated
cases.invariant: The nonce, not the message count, decides
cases.detail: Baseline released (no refusal); the intervention refused with REPLAY_BLOCKED.

cases.title: A funded escrow presented after its deadline
cases.detail: Baseline refused (EXPIRED); the intervention refused with EXPIRED.

cases.title: A final decision whose verdict is REJECT
cases.invariant: Finality plus acceptance is the authority; either alone is not enough
cases.detail: Baseline refused (VERDICT_NOT_APPROVE); the intervention refused with VERDICT_NOT_APPROVE.

control.description: Negative control on the corpus: the release cases must actually be released by the intervention. A guard that refuses everything would otherwise score identically on the refusal cases.
control.detail: 3 of 3 release cases were released by the intervention; the baseline released 7 of 10 refusal cases.
